Name: Marnie sells eggs milk ETC
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Marnie sells eggs, milk, ETCMarnie has and sells chickens, ducks, pigs, goats, cows, sheep and rabbitts. I always wondered why she didn't sell eggs, milk, etc. She even mentions spilling some of the milk and getting eggs from the chickens. Jas mentions ice cream made from fresh milk. This mod adds in all animal products and related machines including Auto-Petter. I did not include cloth and loom because I thought yes she gets wool but can't see her taking the time to make cloth. (That's something Emily would do.)
